tool_definitions.name: bash
tool_definitions.description: A scenario tool that waits for its task to settle. A call still running after 1 active second continues in the background; set background=true to start it there at once. A task runs until it exits or you stop it, unless the tool has its own time limit. To wait for a task, you can just end your turn.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: start this call as a background task

parameters.name: task_name
parameters.description: an optional name; use a single word matching [a-z0-9-]{1,10}, such as build or docs; never add a number yourself, since a repeated name is numbered automatically

parameters.name: forward_port
parameters.description: a fixed server TCP port to make reachable to the user when starting a background task

parameters.name: respawn
parameters.description: restart after each run exits; requires background; stops after 3 runs in a row each end within 2s

tool_definitions.name: task
tool_definitions.description: manage background tool invocations and read their live output. Restart reuses the saved tool arguments. Discard stops the task and removes its record. A completion reports its result and wakes the conversation, so end your turn to wait for a task. Never wait with sleep or by polling its status.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: the task name or id, except for list and prune
